==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A traveling hero guild puts me through a secret initiation. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The traveling hero guild was made up of werewolves dressed in black armor. They called themselves the Wolf Pack.) (I didn't know they were heroes or that they were trying to recruit me, as they initially portrayed themselves as villains. This is a part of their secret initiation process.)
I pass their test by defeating the leader with my divine lightning spell. (My divine lightning spell is Keraunos, which smites my enemies by striking them with godly lightning from the sky above.)
I refuse their membership offer, because the Elven Village is my home and still needs my protection.
